model: finite deterministic functional modules; not arbitrary living-protein prediction
sellerPrice: immutable project price per class, set by project creator
combinedRounding: one floor per root per closed hour after combining its ordinary and valid champion weight

settlement.legacyHourSchema3: explicit ordered completion only; no relabel or ADVANCE
settlement.freezeFrontier: complete real due-event prefix, then freeze immutable membership count, ordinary and unique K weights, denominator and hourly budget
settlement.advanceFrozenHour: advance the global frontier without allocating, sealing, minting or transferring any reward balance
settlement.historicalAccrual: each actual Position advances in hour order; distinct Roots may accrue in arbitrary order against the frozen snapshot
settlement.finalResidual: seal budget minus actually allocated sum only after the entire frozen member count is materialized
settlement.endEvent: future denominator removal does not depend on historical accrual
settlement.transferAndConsume: require only the input Root's own complete ended interval coverage; historical beneficiary debt persists
settlement.restake: nonoverlapping new intervals may queue while old coverage remains; new interval accrual cannot skip its own earlier intervals
settlement.emptySkip: seal only the proven empty forward range; preserve all earlier unfinished lazy budgets
settlement.rentRefund: only FINAL completed hours close; refund the immutable original opener

openingRequiredSetSemantics: Original16 required K0 and u16 bitmap/H15 remain fixed. Register the published additional C310 as the17th warm K0; sealing scans all entries and must reject a frontier above310. A genuinely better prewarm discovery is also public K0.
novelty: actual canonical H7/H8 disclosure and valid earlier commitment; strictly lower cost than bounded accepted baseline
claim: actual accrued minus already paid by permanent beneficiary Position CAS; never promised future output
emptyHours: sealed, never reassigned to later participants
